name: Nahua nobles at the court of Charles V
traveler: Nahua nobles, performers and ballplayers with Cortés
summary: Cortés sails for Spain with Nahua nobles, sons of Moctezuma among them, with ballplayers, jugglers and acrobats. At Charles V's court the German artist Christoph Weiditz draws them playing ullamaliztli with a rubber ball. In 1529 a few go on to Rome and are received by Pope Clement VII, who grants bulls for churches in their home towns.

stops.note: They leave the rebuilt city with Cortés.
At the emperor's court, Weiditz draws the ballplayers and jugglers.
Most of the nobles wait here for months.
